notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 532210 was the only app-list match; the Steam schema calls it "Promenade" (an internal codename). RAWG's first search result matched the expected slug; RAWG also lists the episodes as separate entries (for example "Life is Strange 2 - Episode 1" and "Episode 2"), which were not used. 11 of 46 Steam achievements are hidden. They were placed by their Steam API names: ACH_E2_FinishEp and ACH_E2_DrawSequ go to Episode 2, and so on through Episode 5; the three without an episode number (ACH_WolfPack "Wolf Pack", ACH_OnTheRoadAgain "A Long Road Ahead", ACH_TheSketchyWay "Sketchy") sit among the Episode 1 achievements in the Steam list, so they were put with Episode 1, a guess. Each episode has six optional collectibles plus an all-collectibles achievement, the natural checklist. StrategyWiki has no page under "Life is Strange 2" or "Life Is Strange 2". life-is-strange.fandom.com answers the API under "Life is Strange 2" with about 104 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
